title: Business transactions between a partner and the partnership.
bodyText: A partner may lend money to and transact other business with the limited partnership and has the same rights and obligations with respect to the loan or other transaction as a person who is not a partner.
bodyHtml: [§425E-112]  Business transactions between a partner and the partnership.  A partner may lend money to and transact other business with the limited partnership and has the same rights and obligations with respect to the loan or other transaction as a person who is not a partner. [L 2003, c 210, pt of §1]
